subject: Sponsor track & technical gates — clarifying procurement path and p95 targets
messages:
From: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medisys.com>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Follow-up + open items from today (procurement path + p95 targets)

Neha / Karthik — thanks again for the demo earlier. Quick recap and a few open items from our side so we can align with procurement and engineering: 

- Economic sponsor: Tom Evans (CFO) is the decision owner for_platform spend. I will loop him in after we have a clear procurement checklist.
- Security contact: Rajiv (cc'd) will own the SOC2/RFI artifacts and will need the security questionnaire filled out.
- Key decision criteria we care about:
  * Latency: target p95 for end-user chat < 200ms (we may tighten depending on scale)
  * Cost: we need a 12-month unit-cost estimate (1M token / month baseline) and a delta for dedicated vs hosted
  * Deployment: preference for private VPC if we can meet latency; otherwise dedicated-reserved capacity is acceptable
- Procurement timeline: target procurement approval window is mid-June. Procurement will want clear SLAs and an implementation SOW.

Can you confirm: 1) who on Redwood will be the day-to-day technical contact for Rajiv's RFI, and 2) a short list of SLA commitments you can offer (uptime + latency targets) that we can pass to procurement?

I'll also share our internal procurement template if helpful.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Chen
Product Manager, MediSys Health
Attachment: MediSys_RFI_Security.xlsx (stub)

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medisys.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 18:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + open items from today (procurement path + p95 targets)

Laura — great to connect, thanks for the clear list. High level answers and ownership from our side below. I copied David (solutions) and Karthik (infra/product) for technical + procurement details.

1) Redwood point people
   - Technical / RFI: david_kim (solutions architect) will own the security questionnaire and provide the artifacts Rajiv needs.
   - Commercial / legal: karthik_iyer will coordinate SOW and procurement terms.
   - Deal lead: neha_kapoor (me) will coordinate timelines and the exec sponsor intro.

2) SLA and p95 guidance (initial):
   - Uptime: we can offer up to 99.9% monthly uptime SLA for Dedicated and Private deployments (enterprise contract).
   - Latency: typical p95 for chat on our Redwood-hosted models at comparable scale is ~120–180ms (depends on request size and KV cache hit-rate). For Private/VPC, we have achieved p95 <200ms in customer benchmarks on colocated infra; dedicated-reserved pools can be optimized further by pinning model variants and using batching tweaks.

3) Cost/estimate ask
   - We'll generate a 12-month cost projection for 1M tokens/month and include a dedicated-reserved vs hosted comparison. Expect that in the next email with a cost CSV.

4) Next steps / timeline
   - David will start the RFI responses tomorrow and share artifacts within 48 hours.
   - Karthik will draft a preliminary SOW and pricing worksheet by Friday.
   - Neha to schedule a follow-up call w/ Tom + procurement the week of 5/24 — does that work for you, Laura?

Are there any hard blockers we should know about from procurement (e.g., mandatory on-prem, infosec approvals that require an in-person audit)?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
--
Redwood Inference
Attachment: postcall-agenda.docx (stub)

From: jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com>, neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + open items from today (procurement path + p95 targets)

Laura / Neha — quick clarifications from our side. Quoting Laura below for context.

On Tue, May 18, 2027 at 3:10 PM Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com> wrote:
> - Latency: target p95 for end-user chat < 200ms

We can support that target; two notes to set expectations:
- If the customer chooses Private (on their VPC), typical p95 is driven by network topology — colocated infra + peering reduces network-induced tail latency. We will include network configuration best practices in the SOW.
- For Hosted/Dedicated, we can hit p95 ~120–180ms for chat for the demo-sized workloads you showed. At scale, p95 will vary with concurrent request patterns; we recommend a canary phase with a throttled traffic ramp to validate.

Procurement asks we expect:
- Standard T&Cs + Data Processing Addendum (we have templates)
- SLA: propose committing to 99.9% uptime and a latency escalation policy for regressions (we can offer service credits tied to p95 breaches).

Action items from us:
- David: lead the RFI responses (Rajiv) and provide sys-arch artifacts.
- Karthik: draft SOW and a deployment-runbook for Private option.

Jordan Blake
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: None

From: Tom Evans <tom.evans@medisys.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com>, Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medisys.com>
Date: Wed, 19 May 2027 11:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + open items from today (procurement path + p95 targets)

Neha / team — thanks. A couple of clarifications from the econ side before we loop procurement formally:

- p95: for our use case the end-to-end p95 must be below 150ms for chat in production; embeddings are less sensitive (p95 < 300ms is fine). Can you commit to supporting a 150ms p95 target in the SOW for Dedicated/Private?
- Cost: please include an itemized cost-per-1M-tokens baseline and a readout for expected unit-cost reductions at 10M tokens and 50M tokens scale. Procurement wants to see simple arithmetic they can present (annualized).
- Procurement timing: we will aim for a procurement review week of Jun 14–18.

If you can get the SOW & cost workbook to us by Friday that would be ideal.

–Tom Evans
CFO, MediSys Health

Attachment: None

From: neha_kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Evans <tom.evans@medisys.com>, Laura Chen <laura.chen@medisys.com>
Cc: Rajiv Patel <rpatel@medisys.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, david_kim <david_kim@redwood.ai>, jordan_blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 14:00:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Follow-up + open items from today (procurement path + p95 targets)

Tom / Laura — thank you. Quick summary and concrete next steps so procurement has what it needs: 

- p95 commitment: we will include an SLO target of p95 < 150ms for chat in the SOW for Dedicated and Private deployment options, with an explicit escalation path and remediation credits if missed (details to be written by legal). Host-level network caveats and traffic-profile assumptions will be documented.
- Cost workbook: attached is our cost model CSV (Redwood_cost_model_1Mtokens.csv) showing 1M/10M/50M token scenarios and delta by deployment mode.
- RFI / security artifacts: david_kim will send the completed RFI and SOC2 evidence to Rajiv by EOD tomorrow.
- SOW draft: karthik_iyer will circulate SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf for redlines by Friday.
- Proc timeline: we acknowledge your Jun 14–18 procurement window; Neha to schedule a 30-min align call for 5/25 to walk procurement through the SOW/costs — invite to follow.

Requested from you: please confirm who on your procurement/legal team will handle contract negotiation so we can include them on the SOW distribution.

Thanks all — I'll attach the two files mentioned and the agenda.

Neha Kapoor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_cost_model_1Mtokens.csv (stub); SOW_draft_v0.9.pdf (stub)
